fixed_design: Interpolate leading256 of the fixed384 QR coefficients; exact trailing128; old Q.T@Qp overlap exact.
derivation: Let F=Q.T@J and E=solve(Q[S,:],J[S,:])-F. Since the orthogonal residual is perpendicular to every column of Q, hybrid weighted residual energy equals orthogonal residual energy plus sum_c w_c*||E[:256,c]||^2. Exact trailing128 removes only the complementary error energy; no cancellation can reduce the retained leading error.
decision: The fixed exact tail removes only39.95% of interpolation damage. The six captures do not support the premise that interpolation damage is concentrated in the tail. Do not price or run a model for this design.
limitations: Historical six join inputs, not current v17. Weighted factor residual is not terminal error. No labels or outcomes opened; no parameter/rank scan.
